_doc: World definition shared by Python (sim/worldgen) and JS (web). World frame = ENU, metres, origin at runway centre (sea level). Three.js world = (E, U, -N).

runway.name: PLX
runway._heading_doc: true heading of the RWY 33 landing direction (pointing NNW). RWY 15 is the reciprocal (150 deg).

airport_flat_zone._doc: rectangle in runway frame (along, across) metres around the runway centre that worldgen flattens to runway elevation

map._doc: square heightmap centred on origin; texel (row, col): col -> East from -extent/2, row -> North from -extent/2 (row 0 = south). Texel centres at -extent/2 + (i+0.5)*extent/size.
